items.prompt: For n=1 and prerequisite pair (0,0), why is completion impossible?

options.text: Every single course is automatically ready.
options.why: The self-prerequisite prevents course 0 from initially becoming ready.
Course 0 is a real required course; its label does not remove it from the task.

options.text: The course must be emitted twice to satisfy itself.
options.why: A course is not emitted twice to satisfy its own prerequisite.

options.text: A self-edge blocks the only course.
options.why: The self-edge cannot be removed without first processing the blocked course.

items.explanation: The self-edge cannot be removed without first processing the blocked course.
